zh_CN: 这原本是一片不毛之地。
它只有空虚和枯燥，很长一段时间都没有新鲜事物。
en: It is empty and dull, and no fresh things in a long period.

zh_CN: 我和你一样，都被困在这片与世隔绝之地。
en: We are the same, that all of us were stuck in the isolated world.

zh_CN: 所以我们的相遇可谓充满了缘分。
en: So it's a beautiful destiny that we have eventually met.

zh_CN: 本人为康乃馨。之前对你的情况有所了解，算是互相认识了。
en: My name is Carnation. I have known about you before.

zh_CN: 请多指教。我有一系列的疑问。
en: Glad to see you. And I have several questions to ask.
